Adding 358 days to 1360-10-06:  
1360 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules per instructions).  
From Oct 6, 1360:  
Days remaining in 1360 after Oct 6: 31-6 + 30 + 31 = 86 days.  
358 - 86 = 272 days into 1361.  
Jan–Aug 1361 (non-leap year): 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
272 - 243 = 29 days into September 1361.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1361-09-29
